title.zh: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四: 仁宗一
title.raw: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四: 仁宗一 Volume 24 Annals 24: Renzong 1

sentences.zh: 仁宗聖文欽孝皇帝，諱愛育黎拔力八達，順宗次子，武宗之弟也。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong, posthumous name Shengwen Qinxiao, taboo name Ayurbarwada, was the second son of Shunzong and the younger brother of Wuzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong, posthumous name Shengwen Qinxiao, taboo name Ayurbarwada, was the second son of Shunzong and the younger brother of Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰興聖太后，弘吉剌氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.

sentences.zh: 至元二十二年三月丙子生。

translations.literal: He was born in the third month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan, on bingzi day.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the third month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan, on bingzi day.

sentences.zh: 大德九年冬十月，成宗不豫，中宮秉政，詔帝與太后出居懷州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the ninth year of Dade, Emperor Temür fell ill; the inner palace took charge of government; an edict ordered the Emperor and the empress dowager to leave and reside at Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter of the ninth year of Dade, Emperor Temür fell ill; the inner palace took charge of government; an edict ordered the Emperor and the empress dowager to leave and reside at Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 十年冬十二月，至懷州，所過郡縣，供帳華侈，悉令撤去，嚴飭扈從毋擾於民，且諭僉事王毅察而言之，民皆感悅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter of the tenth year, they reached Huaizhou; at every commandery and county passed through, lavish provisions had been set out — all were ordered removed; the entourage was strictly admonished not to disturb the people; and Commissioner of Affairs for Various Duties Wang Yi was instructed to investigate and report; the people were all moved and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter of the tenth year, they reached Huaizhou; at every commandery and county passed through, lavish provisions had been set out — all were ordered removed; the entourage was strictly admonished not to disturb the people; and Commissioner of Affairs for Various Duties Wang Yi was instructed to investigate and report; the people were all moved and pleased.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，成宗崩，時武宗為懷寧王，總兵北邊，戊子，帝與太后聞哀奔赴。

translations.literal: Spring, first month of the eleventh year — Emperor Temür died; at that time Khayishan was Prince of Huaining, commanding troops on the northern frontier; on wuzi day the Emperor and the empress dowager, hearing the death announcement, rushed to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month of the eleventh year — Emperor Temür died; at that time Khayishan was Prince of Huaining, commanding troops on the northern frontier; on wuzi day the Emperor and the empress dowager, hearing the death announcement, rushed to attend.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，至衛輝，經比幹墓，顧左右曰：「紂內荒於色，毒痡四海，比幹諫，紂刳其心，遂失天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin day they reached Weihui; passing the tomb of Bi Gan, the Emperor turned to those beside him and said, "Zhou was debauched within with women and poisoned the four seas; Bi Gan remonstrated, and Zhou cut out his heart — and so lost the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day they reached Weihui; passing the tomb of Bi Gan, the Emperor turned to those beside him and said, "Zhou was debauched within with women and poisoned the four seas; Bi Gan remonstrated, and Zhou cut out his heart — and so lost the realm.

sentences.zh: 」令祠比幹於墓，為後世勸。

translations.literal: " He ordered Bi Gan sacrificed to at his tomb, as encouragement for later ages.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Bi Gan sacrificed to at his tomb, as encouragement for later ages.

sentences.zh: 至漳河，值大風雪，田叟有以盂粥進者，近侍卻不受。

translations.literal: Reaching the Zhang River, they met a great wind and snow; an old field-hand offered bowl-porridge; close attendants refused it.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Zhang River, they met a great wind and snow; an old field-hand offered bowl-porridge; close attendants refused it.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「昔漢光武嘗為寇兵所迫，食豆粥。

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "Formerly Emperor Guangwu of Han was once pressed by bandit soldiers and ate bean porridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Formerly Emperor Guangwu of Han was once pressed by bandit soldiers and ate bean porridge.

sentences.zh: 大丈夫不備嘗艱阻，往往不知稼穡艱難，以致驕惰。

translations.literal: A great man who has not fully tasted hardship often does not know the difficulty of tillage and harvest, and so becomes arrogant and indolent.
translations.idiomatic: A great man who has not fully tasted hardship often does not know the difficulty of tillage and harvest, and so becomes arrogant and indolent.

sentences.zh: 」命取食之。

translations.literal: " He ordered it fetched and eaten.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered it fetched and eaten.

sentences.zh: 賜叟綾一匹，慰遣之。

translations.literal: One bolt of damask was granted the old man, and he was comforted and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: One bolt of damask was granted the old man, and he was comforted and sent away.

sentences.zh: 行次邯鄲，諭縣官曰：「吾慮衛士不法，胥吏科斂，重為民困。

translations.literal: Passing Handan, the Emperor instructed the county officials, "I fear the guards may behave unlawfully and clerks levy exactions, greatly burdening the people.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Handan, the Emperor instructed the county officials, "I fear the guards may behave unlawfully and clerks levy exactions, greatly burdening the people.

sentences.zh: 」乃命王傅巡行察之。

translations.literal: " He then ordered the princely tutors to tour and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: " He then ordered the princely tutors to tour and investigate.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，至大都，與太后入內，哭盡哀，復出居舊邸，日朝夕入哭奠。

translations.literal: Second month, xinhai day — they reached Dadu; the Emperor and the empress dowager entered the inner palace and wept to the full measure of grief; then went out again to reside at the old residence, daily entering morning and evening to weep and offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinhai day — they reached Dadu; the Emperor and the empress dowager entered the inner palace and wept to the full measure of grief; then went out again to reside at the old residence, daily entering morning and evening to weep and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 左丞相阿忽臺等潛謀推皇后伯要真氏稱制，安西王阿難答輔之。

translations.literal: Left chancellor Ahutai and others secretly plotted to install Empress Boheljen as regent, with Prince of Anxi Ananda to assist her.
translations.idiomatic: Left chancellor Ahutai and others secretly plotted to install Empress Boheljen as regent, with Prince of Anxi Ananda to assist her.

sentences.zh: 時左丞相哈剌哈孫答剌罕稱疾，守宿掖門凡三月，密持其機，陽許之，夜遣人啟帝曰：「懷寧王遠，不能猝至，恐變生不測，當先事而發。

translations.literal: At that time left chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan feigned illness, keeping watch at the side gate for three months in all, secretly holding the levers of power; outwardly he agreed with them, but at night sent men to inform the Emperor, "The Prince of Huaining is far off and cannot arrive suddenly; I fear change may arise without warning — we should strike first.
translations.idiomatic: At that time left chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan feigned illness, keeping watch at the side gate for three months in all, secretly holding the levers of power; outwardly he agreed with them, but at night sent men to inform the Emperor, "The Prince of Huaining is far off and cannot arrive suddenly; I fear change may arise without warning — we should strike first.

sentences.zh: 」三月丙寅，帝率衛士入內，召阿忽臺等責以亂祖宗家法，命執之，鞫問辭服，戊辰，伏誅。

translations.literal: " Third month, bingyin day — the Emperor led the guards into the inner palace, summoned Ahutai and others, and charged them with disturbing the ancestral house laws; he ordered them seized; under interrogation they confessed; on wuchen day they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Third month, bingyin day — the Emperor led the guards into the inner palace, summoned Ahutai and others, and charged them with disturbing the ancestral house laws; he ordered them seized; under interrogation they confessed; on wuchen day they were executed.

sentences.zh: 諸王闊闊出、牙忽都等曰：「今罪人斯得，太子實世祖之孫，宜早正天位。

translations.literal: Princes Kuokuochu, Yahudu, and others said, "Now the criminals are obtained; the crown prince is in truth a grandson of Shizu — the celestial throne should early be righted.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Kuokuochu, Yahudu, and others said, "Now the criminals are obtained; the crown prince is in truth a grandson of Shizu — the celestial throne should early be righted.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「王何為出此言也！

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "Princes, why speak such words!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Princes, why speak such words!

sentences.zh: 彼惡人潛結宮壸，構亂我家，故誅之，豈欲作威覬望神器耶？

translations.literal: Those villains secretly joined with the inner palace and plotted disorder in Our house — therefore they were executed; would We wield authority to covet the sacred vessel?
translations.idiomatic: Those villains secretly joined with the inner palace and plotted disorder in Our house — therefore they were executed; would We wield authority to covet the sacred vessel?

sentences.zh: 懷寧王吾兄也，正位為宜。

translations.literal: The Prince of Huaining is Our elder brother — his taking the throne is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Huaining is Our elder brother — his taking the throne is fitting.

sentences.zh: 」乃遣使迎武宗於北邊。

translations.literal: " Envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan from the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " Envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan from the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，帝與太后會武宗於上都。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yichou day — the Emperor and the empress dowager met Khayishan at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yichou day — the Emperor and the empress dowager met Khayishan at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，武宗即位。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Khayishan ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Khayishan ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，詔立帝為皇太子，受金寶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guisi day — an edict installed the Emperor as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guisi day — an edict installed the Emperor as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.

sentences.zh: 遣使四方，旁求經籍，識以玉刻印章，命近侍掌之。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched in all directions to seek out classics and records far and wide; they were marked with jade-carved seals, and close attendants were ordered to keep charge of them.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched in all directions to seek out classics and records far and wide; they were marked with jade-carved seals, and close attendants were ordered to keep charge of them.

sentences.zh: 時有進《大學衍義》者，命詹事王約等節而譯之。

translations.literal: At that time someone presented the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》; the Emperor ordered Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wang Yue and others to abridge and translate it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time someone presented the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》; the Emperor ordered Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wang Yue and others to abridge and translate it.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「治天下，此一書足矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "To govern the realm, this one book suffices.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "To govern the realm, this one book suffices.

sentences.zh: 」因命與《圖象孝經》、《列女傳》並刊行，賜臣下。

translations.literal: " He therefore ordered it published together with the 《Illustrated Classic of Filial Piety》 and the 《Biographies of Eminent Women》, and granted copies to officials below.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore ordered it published together with the 《Illustrated Classic of Filial Piety》 and the 《Biographies of Eminent Women》, and granted copies to officials below.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，受玉冊，領中書省、樞密院。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin day — he received the jade book and took charge of the central secretariat and privy council.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuyin day — he received the jade book and took charge of the central secretariat and privy council.

sentences.zh: 至大元年七月，帝諭詹事曲出曰：「汝舊事吾，其與同僚協議，務遵法度，凡世祖所未嘗行及典故所無者，慎勿行。

translations.literal: Seventh month of the first year of Zhida — the Emperor instructed Supervisor Qu Chu, "You long served Us — deliberate with your colleagues and see that you follow the laws; for whatever Shizu never did and what has no precedent in established practice, take care not to do it.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of the first year of Zhida — the Emperor instructed Supervisor Qu Chu, "You long served Us — deliberate with your colleagues and see that you follow the laws; for whatever Shizu never did and what has no precedent in established practice, take care not to do it.

sentences.zh: 」二年八月，立尚書省，詔太子兼尚書令，戒飭百官有司，振紀綱，重名器，夙夜以赴事功。

translations.literal: " Eighth month of the second year — the Ministry of Revenue was established; an edict made the crown prince concurrently minister of revenue; all officials and offices were admonished to revive discipline and law, value titles and appointments, and labor day and night toward achievement in service.
translations.idiomatic: " Eighth month of the second year — the Ministry of Revenue was established; an edict made the crown prince concurrently minister of revenue; all officials and offices were admonished to revive discipline and law, value titles and appointments, and labor day and night toward achievement in service.

sentences.zh: 詹事院臣啟金州獻瑟瑟洞，請遣使采之，帝曰：「所寶惟賢，瑟瑟何用焉？

translations.literal: Members of the heir apparent's household reported that Jin Prefecture offered a turquoise cave and requested envoys be sent to gather it; the Emperor said, "What is treasured is worthies alone — of what use is turquoise?
translations.idiomatic: Members of the heir apparent's household reported that Jin Prefecture offered a turquoise cave and requested envoys be sent to gather it; the Emperor said, "What is treasured is worthies alone — of what use is turquoise?

sentences.zh: 若此者，後勿復聞。

translations.literal: For such things hereafter, let Us hear no more.
translations.idiomatic: For such things hereafter, let Us hear no more.

sentences.zh: 」先是，近侍言賈人有售美珠者，帝曰：「吾服御雅不喜飾以珠璣，生民膏血，不可輕耗。

translations.literal: " Earlier, a close attendant said a merchant was selling fine pearls; the Emperor said, "Our clothing and use have never favored adornment with pearls and gems; the lifeblood of the people must not be lightly squandered.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, a close attendant said a merchant was selling fine pearls; the Emperor said, "Our clothing and use have never favored adornment with pearls and gems; the lifeblood of the people must not be lightly squandered.

sentences.zh: 汝等當廣進賢才，以恭儉愛人相規，不可以奢靡蠹財相導。

translations.literal: You should broadly advance worthy talent, admonishing one another with reverence, thrift, and love of the people — not guiding one another toward extravagance that devours the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: You should broadly advance worthy talent, admonishing one another with reverence, thrift, and love of the people — not guiding one another toward extravagance that devours the treasury.

sentences.zh: 」言者慚而退。

translations.literal: " The speaker withdrew in shame.
translations.idiomatic: " The speaker withdrew in shame.

sentences.zh: 淮東宣慰使撒都獻玉觀音、七寶帽頂、寶帶、寶鞍，卻之，戒諭如初。

translations.literal: Huaidong pacification commissioner Sadu presented a jade Guanyin, seven-treasures cap finial, treasure belt, and treasure saddle — all were declined, with admonition as before.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong pacification commissioner Sadu presented a jade Guanyin, seven-treasures cap finial, treasure belt, and treasure saddle — all were declined, with admonition as before.

sentences.zh: 詹事王約啟事，二宦者侍側，帝問：「自古宦官壞人家國，有諸？

translations.literal: Supervisor Wang Yue reported on affairs; two eunuchs stood attendant; the Emperor asked, "Since ancient times eunuchs have ruined households and states — is this so?
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Wang Yue reported on affairs; two eunuchs stood attendant; the Emperor asked, "Since ancient times eunuchs have ruined households and states — is this so?

sentences.zh: 」約對曰：「宦官善惡皆有之，但恐處置失宜耳。

translations.literal: Wang Yue replied, "Among eunuchs there are both good and bad — one only fears improper disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yue replied, "Among eunuchs there are both good and bad — one only fears improper disposition.

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 九月，河間等路獻嘉禾，有異畝同穎及一莖數穗者，命集賢學士趙孟頫繪圖，藏諸秘書。

translations.literal: September — Hejian and other routes presented auspicious grain; there were cases of different fields sharing one ear and one stalk bearing several ears; Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhao Mengfu was ordered to paint illustrations, which were stored in the secretariat archives.
translations.idiomatic: September — Hejian and other routes presented auspicious grain; there were cases of different fields sharing one ear and one stalk bearing several ears; Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhao Mengfu was ordered to paint illustrations, which were stored in the secretariat archives.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚辰，武宗崩。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, gengchen day — Khayishan died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, gengchen day — Khayishan died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷尚書省。

translations.literal: On renwu day the Ministry of Revenue was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Ministry of Revenue was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以丞相脫虎脫、三寶奴，平章樂實，右丞保八，左丞忙哥帖木兒，參政王羆，變亂舊章，流毒百姓，命中書右丞相塔思不花、知樞密院事鐵木兒不花等參鞫。

translations.literal: Because grand chancellors Toghto and Sanbaonu, grand councillor Leshi, right vice chancellor Baoba, left vice chancellor Mangqutemür, and associate administrator Wang Bi had altered and thrown into disorder the old regulations and spread poison among the people, central secretariat right chancellor Tasibuhua, director of privy council affairs Temür Buhua, and others were ordered to join in interrogating them.
translations.idiomatic: Because grand chancellors Toghto and Sanbaonu, grand councillor Leshi, right vice chancellor Baoba, left vice chancellor Mangqutemür, and associate administrator Wang Bi had altered and thrown into disorder the old regulations and spread poison among the people, central secretariat right chancellor Tasibuhua, director of privy council affairs Temür Buhua, and others were ordered to join in interrogating them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，脫虎脫、三寶奴、樂實、保八、王羆伏誅，忙哥帖木兒杖流海南。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Toghto, Sanbaonu, Leshi, Baoba, and Wang Bi were executed; Mangqutemür was beaten and banished to Hainan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Toghto, Sanbaonu, Leshi, Baoba, and Wang Bi were executed; Mangqutemür was beaten and banished to Hainan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On renzi day the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 罷城中都。

translations.literal: Central Capital was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital was abolished.

sentences.zh: 召世祖朝諳知政務素有聲望老臣平章程鵬飛、董士選，太子少傅李謙，少保張驢，右丞陳天祥、尚文、劉正，左丞郝天挺，中丞董士珍，太子賓客蕭，參政劉敏中、王思廉、韓從益，侍御趙君信，謙訪使程鉅夫，杭州路達魯花赤阿合馬，給傳詣闕，同議庶務。

translations.literal: Former ministers of Shizu's reign versed in government affairs and long of established reputation were summoned — grand councillor Cheng Pengfei, Dong Shixuan, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Li Qian, Junior Guardian Zhang Lü, right vice chancellors Chen Tianxiang, Shang Wen, and Liu Zheng, left vice chancellor Hao Tianting, censor-in-chief Dong Shizhen, Guest of the Heir Apparent Xiao Yi, associate administrators Liu Minzhong, Wang Siliang, and Han Congyi, attendant censor Zhao Junxin, surveillance commissioner Cheng Jufu, and Hangzhou Route darughachi Ahema — relay transport was granted for them to proceed to court and jointly deliberate common affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Former ministers of Shizu's reign versed in government affairs and long of established reputation were summoned — grand councillor Cheng Pengfei, Dong Shixuan, junior tutor of the heir apparent Li Qian, junior guardian Zhang Lü, right vice chancellors Chen Tianxiang, Shang Wen, and Liu Zheng, left vice chancellor Hao Tianting, censor-in-chief Dong Shizhen, guest of the heir apparent Xiao Yi, associate administrators Liu Minzhong, Wang Siliang, and Han Congyi, attendant censor Zhao Junxin, surveillance commissioner Cheng Jufu, and Hangzhou Route darughachi Ahema — relay transport was granted for them to proceed to court and jointly deliberate common affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宥阿附脫虎脫等左右司、六部官罪。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the guilt of left and right secretariat directors and six ministry officials who had attached themselves to Toghto and others was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the guilt of left and right secretariat directors and six ministry officials who had attached themselves to Toghto and others was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁百官役軍人營造及守護私第。

translations.literal: On yiwei day officials were forbidden to impress soldiers for construction or to guard private residences.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day officials were forbidden to impress soldiers for construction or to guard private residences.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以雲南行中書省左丞相鐵木叠兒為中書右丞相，太子詹事完澤、集賢大學士李孟並平章政事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Temüder was made central secretariat right chancellor; Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze and Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng were both made grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Temüder was made central secretariat right chancellor; supervisor of the heir apparent's household Wanze and Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng were both made grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以塔思不花及徽政院使沙沙並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Tasibuhua and Bureau of Imperial Manufactures commissioner Shasha were both made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Tasibuhua and Bureau of Imperial Manufactures commissioner Shasha were both made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改行尚書省為行中書省。

translations.literal: On jihai day branch ministries of revenue were changed to branch secretariats.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day branch ministries of revenue were changed to branch secretariats.

sentences.zh: 庚子，減價糶京倉米，日千石，以賑貧民。

translations.literal: On gengzi day capital granary rice was sold at reduced price — one thousand shi daily — to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day capital granary rice was sold at reduced price — 1,000 shi daily — to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 停各處營造。

translations.literal: Construction at all locations was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Construction at all locations was halted.

sentences.zh: 罷廣武康裏衛，追還印符、驛券、璽書，及其萬戶等官宣敕。

translations.literal: Guangwu Kangli Guard was abolished; seals, relay certificates, and imperial letters were recovered, together with the commissions of its commanders of ten thousand households and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: Guangwu Kangli Guard was abolished; seals, relay certificates, and imperial letters were recovered, together with the commissions of its commanders of ten thousand households and other officials.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以塔失鐵木兒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Tash Temür was made director of privy council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Tash Temür was made director of privy council affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁鷹坊馳驛擾民。

translations.literal: On renyin day falconry offices were forbidden to rush relay transport and disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day falconry offices were forbidden to rush relay transport and disturb the people.
